dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Phew... And another one bites the dust. Just where did all these Slimes pop out from...

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Oh, it was just a Slime! Every Knight can do that.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: I don't know why, but their numbers out here in the wild have been skyrocketing recently. They've even started attacking travelers on the roads.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: In order to ensure the safety of the area, both the Adventurers' Guild and the Knights have had to send people out on patrol and to eliminate the monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Between ensuring that the city's well-guarded and pursuing monsters beyond its walls nonstop... Everyone's been run ragged! People are so tired they can barely deploy their wind gliders.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: But before Albedo comes up with some sort of solution, someone's gotta get rid of the monsters, right?

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Me? I'm... I'm doing fine. After all, I'm used to fighting out here, so I know how to conserve my strength and choose the best way to engage!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: #We can talk more later, I've got another area to patrol. You should head back to Mondstadt for now. I'll see you around, {NICKNAME}!
